title: Host Attachment
items: Which resource should be used to check host compatibility for host attachment?
各協定與作業系統的相容性請查 IBM System Storage Interoperation Center (SSIC)。
What does the IBM Storage Virtualize plugin for vSphere provide?
Provisioning and management of IBM storage from within the vCenter UI
Backup of virtual machines to tape
vSphere Plugin 以 VMware Remote Plugin 架構，讓管理者在 vCenter 介面內佈建與管理 IBM 儲存。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch6 Using VMware
Which VMware solution does the IBM Storage Virtualize Family Storage Replication Adapter (SRA) integrate with?
SRA 與 VMware Site Recovery Manager 整合，用於執行 Disaster Recovery Failover 情境。
Which component provides block storage services for OpenStack?
IBM Storage Virtualize family volume management driver (Cinder driver)
OpenStack 使用 IBM Storage Virtualize Family Volume Driver (前稱 Storwize Cinder Driver)，支援 Wallaby 至 Flamingo 等版本。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch6 Using OpenStack
Which OpenStack release is listed as supported with this release?
Which components integrate IBM FlashSystem with Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation?
ODF FlashSystem Operator and ODF FlashSystem Driver
OpenShift Data Foundation 使用 ODF FlashSystem Operator 與 ODF FlashSystem Driver 與 IBM FlashSystem 整合。
Offloads copy operations from the host to the storage array
Offloaded Data Transfer (ODX) 將複製工作卸載給儲存陣列；簡報註明 Storage Partition 內的 Volume 不支援。
Is NPIV in the host bus adapter supported when directly attached to the system's FC ports?
No, only when connected through a SAN switch
HBA 使用 NPIV 經 SAN Switch 連接受支援，直接接到系統 FC Port 時不受支援。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch6 SCSI Fibre Channel host attachments
Which attributes must be enabled for AIX 5.2 or later hosts?
AIX 5.2 以上需啟用 fast fail (fc_err_recov=fast_fail) 與 dynamic tracking (dyntrk=yes)。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch6 Configuring for fast fail
Which command enables dynamic tracking on AIX adapter fscsi0?
`chdev -l fscsi0 -a dyntrk=yes` 啟用 dynamic tracking；另一個指令設定 fast_fail。AIX 7.1 預設已啟用 dynamic tracking。
Which multipathing support is provided on IBM Power Systems AIX hosts?
IBM Power AIX 由 AIX Path Control Module (AIXPCM) 提供 Multipathing。
Concept Guide Ch6 Multipath support for IBM Power Systems hosts
Which multipathing driver should be used for Windows Server?
Windows Server 使用內建的 MSDSM，Hyper-V 也內含。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch6 Windows Server
What disk I/O timeout value should be set in the Windows registry?
Windows 的 HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Disk\TimeOutValue 應設為 60 (十進位)。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch6 Changing the disk timeout
What do VMware vSphere Virtual Volumes allow?
VMware vCenter to manage system objects like volumes and pools
系統支援 vSphere Virtual Volumes，讓 vCenter 管理 Volume 與 Pool 等物件。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch6 ESXi Note
Why might ATS heartbeats be disabled on ESXi hosts?
ATS heartbeating increases load and can cause access issues on busy systems, especially during maintenance
ATS heartbeats are required for vVols
ATS Heartbeat 會增加系統負載，在忙碌系統或維護期間可能造成存取問題，可停用以降低負載。
Concept Guide Ch6 VMware ATS heartbeating
What delay in completing heartbeat I/Os can cause ESXi host disconnects with ATS heartbeating?
ATS Heartbeat 逾時值很低，若單一 Heartbeat I/O 延遲 8 秒以上，可能導致 Host 中斷。
Concept Guide Ch6 VMware ATS heartbeating
In a stretched topology with ESXi, what is recommended?
Use Host and VM DRS groups to keep a VM on hosts within the same site and set a site on host objects
Disable site settings on host objects
Map all volumes only to one site
Stretched 時建議用 DRS Group 讓 VM 只移到同站點 Host，並為 ESXi Host Object 設定 Site，避免不必要的跨站點流量。
Concept Guide Ch6 Configuring the ESXi operating system
Auto zoning integrates with which switch feature?
Auto Zoning 與 Brocade Target Driven Zoning 整合，需由 Fabric 管理者對 Port 明確啟用 TDZ。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch6 Zoning and portsets
Which portsets are supported for auto zoning?
Auto Zoning 只支援使用者自訂的 FC Portset。
What type of zone does auto zoning create between host initiators and target ports?
Auto Zoning 在 Host Initiator 與 Target Port 之間建立 Peer Zone。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch6 Peer zone contents
What is the auto zoning zone naming format?
Zone 命名為 IBM_SV_<Target Port WWPN>_00；前綴可用 `chsystem` 設定，須在第一個 Auto Zoning Portset 建立前設定。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch6 Zone Naming Convention
What is the maximum number of paths from a host to a volume per node canister?
4, for a total of 8 per system
2, for a total of 4 per system
8, for a total of 16 per system
16, for a total of 32 per system
Host 到 Volume 的路徑每個 Node Canister 不得超過 4 條，單一系統共 8 條。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch6 Paths to hosts
If high availability is configured between two systems, what is the total supported number of paths for a host to a volume?
兩系統 HA 時仍為每 Node Canister 4 條，兩系統合計 16 條；超過即不受支援。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch6 Paths to hosts
Which command finds the WWPNs required to set up FC zoning with hosts and shows host I/O port failover status?
`lstargetportfc` 顯示建立 Host Zoning 所需的 WWPN，並顯示 Host I/O Port 的 Failover 狀態。
Concept Guide Ch6 Paths to hosts
WWPN 為 8 bytes、16 個十六進位字元 (0–9、A–F)，用來唯一識別 Host 的 FC 介面卡。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch6 Fibre Channel port-name identification
What is the recommended HBA queue depth for most hosts?
大多數 Host 建議 HBA Queue Depth 為 32；較忙或 Host 數少時可設 128。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch6 Queue depth
What is the maximum total queue depth for all hosts connected to a single physical FC port on the storage system?
連到同一實體 FC Port 的所有 Host Queue Depth 總和不得超過 2048。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch6 Queue depth
If queue full failures regularly occur, what should you consider?
Reducing queue depths or distributing host zoning across more physical FC ports
Using a single FC port for all hosts
經常出現 queue full 時，可降低 Queue Depth，或將 Host Zoning 分散到更多實體 FC Port。
In which RFC is iSCSI defined?
iSCSI 定義於 RFC 3720，在 IP 網路上傳送 SCSI 指令。
Which iSCSI initiator type is supported for host attachment?
Software initiator only; hardware iSCSI initiators are not supported
不支援 Hardware iSCSI Initiator，必須使用 Software Initiator。
How many connections per iSCSI session are supported?
每個 iSCSI Session 僅支援一條 Connection (max_connections = 1)。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch6 iSCSI session parameters
只支援 ErrorRecoveryLevel 0，即以 Session 重啟方式復原。
Can the same iSCSI initiator use IPv4 and IPv6 at the same time?
同一個 Initiator 不可同時使用 IPv4 與 IPv6。
Which iSCSI discovery method is NOT supported?
系統不支援 SLP 探索；可設定 iSNS Server 位址。
Which command configures an IP address on a node Ethernet port for iSCSI?
以 `mkip` 設定 Node Ethernet Port 的 IP 並指定 Portset，`lsportethernet` 檢視，`rmip` 移除。
What must you do on the host when the iSCSI host object is created or re-created on the system?
Log out of existing sessions and log in again
系統端建立或重建 iSCSI Host Object 後，Host 需先登出既有 Session 再重新登入。
What does the iSCSI host status Degraded indicate?
The host is logged in to one or both nodes without a vdisk mapping
The host is logged in to both nodes with a vdisk mapped
The host has no active sessions
Online：登入兩個 Node 且有映射；Degraded：已登入但沒有 vdisk Mapping；Offline：沒有任何 Session。
Concept Guide Ch6 iSCSI host object status
When using CHAP on Windows with multiple sessions, what is required?
Each session from the same host uses the same secret
Each session uses a different secret
Windows 使用 CHAP 時，同一 Host 的各 Session 必須使用相同的 Secret。
What is a typical symptom that TCP Delayed ACK should be disabled?
Read performance is much lower than write performance
Write performance is much lower than read
讀取效能明顯低於寫入是典型徵兆，Outstanding I/O 為 1 時影響最大。
What MTU does the system support for jumbo frames on iSCSI ports?
系統支援 MTU 9000，以 `chportethernet` 設定，設定時會使 Link 中斷並暫停該 Port 的 I/O。
How can you verify end-to-end jumbo frame support from a Windows host?
使用不可分段的 Ping 驗證，例如 Windows 的 `ping -f -l 8964`。
For iSCSI port balance, how should subnets be used?
Each iSCSI port uses a different subnet, and the corresponding ports on each node use the same subnet
All ports on all nodes use one subnet
Each node uses a different subnet for all ports
每個 iSCSI Port 使用不同 Subnet，各 Node 對應 Port 使用相同 Subnet；Subnet 數最好等於 Node 的 iSCSI Port 數。
Why should host logins be balanced across all iSCSI ports?
Each port maps to a CPU, so balanced logins fully use the system
The system only allows 5 hosts per port
每個 iSCSI Port 對應一個 CPU，登入數平衡才能充分利用，例如避免 50 台 Host 登入 Port 1 而 Port 2 只有 5 台。
If iSCSI discovery cannot see the target IP, what should you check?
That the target IP and the host object belong to the same portset
That the host has no CHAP secret
iSCSI Discovery 或 Login 失敗時，確認 Target IP 與 Host Object 屬於同一個 Portset。
What is the maximum number of ports an FC-NVMe host can connect to on a single node?
4, plus up to 4 on the partner node for failover
FC-NVMe Host 單一 Node 最多連 4 個 Port，Partner Node 另外最多 4 個 Port 用於 Failover。
Which tool must be installed on Linux hosts for NVMe attachment?
Linux 需確認 HBA Firmware 與 Driver，並安裝 nvme-cli (SLES 用 zypper，RHEL 用 yum)。
When a software router is in the path between host and target, which NVMe transport should be used?
NVMe/RDMA 需要 Host 與 Target Port 間為直接 Layer-2 Ethernet；有路由器時改用支援路由網路的 NVMe/TCP。
Are direct-attached hosts supported for NVMe over RDMA and NVMe over TCP?
NVMe over RDMA 與 NVMe over TCP 都不支援直連 Host。
Windows initiates ODX only for transfers larger than what size?
Windows 只對大於 256 KB 的傳輸啟動 ODX；且只有 NTFS Volume 能啟動 ODX。
Which PowerShell setting value means ODX is enabled?
FilterSupportedFeaturesMode 為 0 表示啟用、1 表示停用，可設回 0。
